title: Hearty Ukrainian Bread Flour Casserole
description: A silky, malty casserole that melds bread flour with savory vegetables, finished with a flambé for a touch of drama.
instructions: Heat the copper pot over medium heat and add olive oil.
Sauté onion and garlic until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add carrot and potato and cook for another 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sprinkle bread flour over the vegetables, stir to coat, and cook for 2 minutes to remove raw flour taste.
Pour in vegetable broth, add bay leaf, salt, pepper, and malt syrup, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let the mixture thicken and flavors meld for 25 minutes.
Remove the pot from heat, pour the casserole onto a heat‑resistant surface, and carefully ignite the cognac over the top for a flambé finish.
Allow the flames to die out, stir once, then serve hot.
